description: source remove of the entry that gives a source its only backend while other files keep entries for it without one (k137): exit 1 before anything else, --force or not, naming every such file and its way out – `skilletor source remove <name>` with or without --project, a hand edit for skilletor.local.json – nothing written, no sync. Once the project's override is gone the local file's alone is named; a backend-less entry goes as any other, and once a source's overrides are gone the source goes too.
